title: Heated fin (thermal strain)
sentence: A fin with assumed aluminium properties, fixed at its root and uniformly heated — thermal strain with no mechanical load at all.

expected.reference: no closed form; the restraint is what makes the stress

theory: A uniform temperature change produces a free thermal strain $\varepsilon_{th} = \alpha\,\Delta T$ in every direction. Restraining the root is what turns that strain into stress; a fully free body would expand and stay stress-free. The numerical aluminium properties are assumed illustrative inputs for this example, not certified 6061-T6 or EN 573-3 material data.
